name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Premium reliability, security, and settings pass. Cross-server playback now keeps the Play button for universally allowed items and uses signed item/user-scoped stream capabilities with live revocation checks, fixing ordinary-user playback without exposing peer credentials. The injected cloud badge is polished, optional, and off by default. Settings now have a local-only Catalog for exact outgoing exclusions and a remote-only Downloads workspace with newest-first Movie/TV filtering and already-local warnings. Better-copy replacement is a staged opt-in with one explicit confirmation per title; it downloads to a partial file, validates and commits the replacement, then rechecks the exact match before removing the old copy. Includes responsive laptop/TV polish, accessibility improvements, 347 passing .NET tests run twice, jsdom coverage, Chromium layout checks, and a two-server admin/non-admin range-playback matrix.
